# STEREO VIBE

> A one-click starter kit that turns a bare Windows or macOS machine into a working
> AI-coding setup: it installs Git, Node and a coding-agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex or
> Gemini), verifies sign-in and endpoint reachability, then scaffolds the agent's project
> memory — a CLAUDE.md plus a memory/ folder pre-filled from the checks it just ran.

Two self-contained scripts, no dependencies, no keys, no build step. The console UX is
Russian; status tags, exit codes and the JSON report are language-neutral. Telemetry is
off unless you pass your own endpoint.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): what it does step by step, install, how to read the output, design decisions, roadmap, limitations
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): constraints that are not visible in the code

## Code
- [Windows entry point](windows/run-check-windows.cmd): ASCII-only launcher, self-elevates through UAC
- [Windows report-only entry point](windows/core/run-check-report-only.cmd): changes nothing
- [Windows core](windows/core/check-work-tools.ps1): all checks, repair, memory scaffolding, agent launch
- [macOS entry point](macos/START-macOS.command): clears Gatekeeper quarantine, sets the exec bit
- [macOS core](macos/core/check-work-tools-macos.command): the same checks over Homebrew

## Memory templates
- [CLAUDE.md template](templates/CLAUDE.md): the rules the agent reads before touching anything
- [CLAUDE.ru.md](templates/CLAUDE.ru.md): the Russian original the workshop ships
- [infra_status template](templates/memory/infra_status.template.md): filled in by the installer from live detection
- [memory scheme](templates/memory/README.md): status is overwritten, history only grows, backlog lives in between
